summary: Arrow Financial Corporation filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, announcing that its subsidiary Upstate Agency, LLC entered a definitive agreement to acquire Skene Valley Agency, Inc., an independent insurance agency based in Granville, Washington County, New York, founded in 2002 with satellite offices in Whitehall and Cambridge. Following closing, Skene Valley will merge into Upstate Agency, expanding personal and commercial insurance operations. No purchase price, stake percentage, financing terms, advisor, or board recommendation were disclosed. Closing is targeted by end of Q3 2026, implying the first calendar quarter. Watch for deal value disclosure, regulatory approvals, and integration execution risk.
